title: Links in existing cases, re-tested on a second key
question: Where a case rests on a name or an address alone, do the registry, the address file or another official record give a second, independent key?
finding: 10 links were re-tested. 4 gain a second key (a contract number or a shared address), 2 are strengthened or narrowed, and the rest are unchanged.
how: Each link is looked up in the business registry by its exact names and addresses, and the official record that could carry a second key (Airport Commission minutes, City College order reports, IRS returns, Secretary of State statements) is read for it.
limits: A shared address shows two records in one place, not common ownership. People are matched only as the cases already match them and are not named here beyond what the cases print.

rows.link: payee ROYAL ELECTRIC CO and bidder Royal Electric Company
rows.found: The Controller's contract file has ROYAL ELECTRIC CO as prime on AIR-10551.61-AirfieldSignUpgra (from 2017-03-16); the Airport Commission's minutes of 19 June 2018 name the contractor on Contract No. 10551.61 "Vellutini Corporation dba Royal Electric Company". The registry has 1 account trading as Royal Electric Company: Vellutini Corporation, Sacramento, industry code 23, open since 2012-03-01.
rows.verdict: UPGRADED for the payee (contract number is the second key: the payee is Vellutini Corporation dba Royal Electric Company). The 2026 bidder is still joined by name, trade and department only: the bid abstract gives no licence number.

rows.link: New Reliance Auto Repair Inc on City College order reports
rows.found: City College's purchase-order reports (2024-07_PO-Report.pdf, 2024-08-29_July-2024-PO-Report.pdf) cite 'City & County contract 1000010657' on orders to New Reliance Auto Repair Inc.; the Controller's voucher file pays contract 1000010657 (OCA RFP 99200As Needed Vehicle) only to NEW RELIANCE AUTO REPAIR INC ($1.6 million, fiscal 2019 to 2023). The registry has one account under the name, at 4885 Mission St, industry code 811111.
rows.verdict: UPGRADED: the City contract number on City College's own orders is a second key. The two July 2025 orders do not repeat the number; they carry the same vendor name and the same kind of work.

rows.link: Azul Works Holding / OBS Engineering at 1555 Yosemite Avenue Suite 2; AzulWorks at 1400 Egbert Avenue
rows.found: Registry account 0336856 (Azul Works Inc, industry code 238910): 205 13Th St Suite 3138 (2009-10-21 to 2014-01-01); 1555 Yosemite Ave Suite 2 (2013-12-01 to 2020-02-01); 1400 Egbert Ave (2020-02-01 to open). OBS Engineering, Inc. (account 1089708): 1555 Yosemite Ave Suite 2 (2018-07-02 to open); 531 44Th Ave (2018-07-02 to open). KM 106 Construction Inc.: 630 Cherry Way (2021-01-16 to 2025-06-17); 1400 Egbert Ave (2022-01-01 to open). Accounts ever registered at Suite 2: 4. 1400 Egbert Avenue: assessor class Industrial, Planning 11,760 sq ft commercial and 0 homes. City paid OBS Engineering $3.5 million.
rows.verdict: STRENGTHENED (address key): the City's registry places the debarred AzulWorks itself at 1555 Yosemite Avenue Suite 2 from December 2013 to 1 February 2020, so the suite in Azul Works Holding's June 2016 articles was AzulWorks' registered location then, and OBS Engineering registered at the same suite from July 2018 while AzulWorks was there. Ownership is still not shown; whether the 2016 agent is the AzulWorks chief stays a name match.

rows.link: Civic Method Co and NexStreet (the chief executive of the same name); NexStreet and Lower Polk
rows.found: NexStreet's State statements (14 Nov 2024, 29 Sep 2025) give [a residential address] as principal office and as the chief executive's address. The City registry's first location of Civic Method Co (account 1168243, industry code 561790) is the same unit (2025-01-17 to 2025-07-01); NexStreet LLC is registered at 8055 Collins Dr, Oakland (2021-01-01 to 2025-06-30, closed by the Tax Collector: yes); an account in the name 'Nexsteet - Cleaning And Sanitation' (janitorial code 561720) opened on 2023-04-01 at 1170 Sutter St, where Lower Polk Community Benefit District has been registered since 2018-01-23.
rows.verdict: UPGRADED (address key): Civic Method Co first registered with the City at the unit NexStreet gives as its office and its chief executive's address, so the two chief executives share a name and an address. NEW: NexStreet's San Francisco registration uses the street address of the district that paid it.

rows.link: SF New Deal in the Attorney General's registry and the City payee
rows.found: The City registry has one SF New Deal account (1117734, opened 2020-03-23, code 813410): 2501 Phelps St (2020-03-23 to 2022-11-18); 60 29Th St Suite 310 (2022-11-18 to 2025-09-30); 654 Mission St (2025-10-01 to open). The IRS returns of employer number 85-0498939 (SF New Deal) give 2501 Phelps Street (2020); 2501 Phelps Street (2021); 60 29th Street 310 (2022); 60 29th Street 310 (2023); 60 29th Street 310 (2023); 654 Mission Street (2024). The Attorney General's search result gives only the city and a fiscal year ending 31 December.
rows.verdict: NARROWED, still unknown: the City registry account and the IRS filer are tied by the same three addresses in the same order, but the Attorney General record on disk carries no employer number or address; its renewal filings would settle it.

rows.link: What the Human Services Agency paid Celerity Consulting Group for
rows.found: Of $1.3 million paid to CELERITY CONSULTING GROUP INC, $1.3 million is booked as Property Rent in fiscal 2019 to 2020, under the titles 'HSA: Rent: 2 Gough St FY 18/19'; 'HSA: Rent: 2 Gough St FY 19/20'; 'Lease Agrmnt: 2 Gough Street'. RACHRIS LLC's Property Rent ($7.4 million) starts in fiscal 2020; both were paid under 'HSA: Rent: 2 Gough St FY 19/20'.
rows.verdict: UPGRADED (a second key, the same lease): the agency's payments to the consultant were rent for 2 Gough Street, and the same rent passed to RACHRIS LLC in fiscal 2020. One landlord under two names is the plain reading; who owns either company is still not on file.
